name: California 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club, SPIN club or camp in your county. You start with one project and can join county and state events.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 5 to 18 by Dec 31 of the 4-H year, anywhere in California.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Your county sets a fee, and some projects cost extra. Fee waivers are available.
duration: The 4-H year runs July to June.
deadline_text: Join any time. Animal shows at county fairs have their own deadlines.
how_to_apply: Find your county 4-H office on the Join page. A parent signs up in ZSuite and pays the county fee.
notes: The old ucanr.edu/sites/ca4H address now goes to this page. Projects and fees depend on your county.
